note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of today. No adverse finding was established, but this is NOT a clean bill of health — it reflects a research failure, not an absence of risk. Tooling problems: the DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt; Bing returned the same cached, query-independent result set (unrelated 'Colorz' brands: colorz.cc, Marvell COLORZ optical modules, a video game, a Paris Shopify agency) for three different queries, so it is unusable as evidence; Google returned HTTP 429; Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck and InstaFinancials all returned HTTP 403. Sanctions: the OFAC Sanctions List Search page loaded but is a JavaScript form that cannot be queried via plain GET, so no name match was actually executed — sanctions_hit is null because the check could not be completed, NOT because a negative result was obtained. UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were not queried at all. Indian courts: Indian Kanoon was reachable and returned 0 results for both "Colorz India" and "Colorz India Private Limited" (tribunal filter also 0). The only 'Colorz' litigation found is a DIFFERENT entity — Colorz N Style Private Limited, New Delhi, ITAT Delhi ITA No.1492/Del/2021 (AY 2019-20, order 25.02.2022) and a related PF/deduction matter cited in Hind Securities Services & House vs ITO Ward-28(5) Delhi (25.04.2022) — this must not be attributed to Colorz India Private Limited. Note Indian Kanoon does not index all district courts, NCLT or consumer fora, so court_cases=null means 'not found in indexed databases', not 'no litigation'. Credit rating: no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action located; null. Regulator actions and negative news: nothing located; null. Russia/CIS supply evidence: nothing located; null — no customs, B-L or trade-data source was reachable to test this. Recommended follow-up before any decision: (1) run the name manually through OFAC, EU, UK OFSI and BIS lists; (2) pull the MCA master data to confirm the legal entity and its status; (3) check NCLT and e-courts directly; (4) query a paid trade/customs database for Russia/CIS flows. Per project rules, no rejection is proposed on this basis — the company stays in the database with these fields unresolved.
